newsitem.title: USA: Roberts sees FDA approval of Agrelin soon.
newsitem.headline: Roberts sees FDA approval of Agrelin soon.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Inc Chairman Robert Vukovich said on Wednesday he expects U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval soon of its Agrelin drug, for the reduction of excess platelets.
The approval would represent the first drug to emerge from Roberts' internal development.

Vukovich said trials showed Agrelin dramatically reduced excess platelet levels in patients within days from the time they were given the drug. Excessive platelet disorder is associated with a number of serious and sometimes fatal diseases, including certain kinds of leukemia.
